title: finding(i18n, a11y): 31 shipped aria-label attributes are literal English, so a non-English screen reader hears English names (the family's closing card)
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible accessibility and localization defect with a named producer. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 2 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#9771, `session_01TYgwmFK1q4KJ6Qq2WRLzsD`). The source is the out-of-scope finding in the objectui#12124 dev report (comment `6109512642`), which the contract review on PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12142 (comment `6109713074`) escalated to the seat. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Read on objectui `main` `dca25af`

- `reach:` named real producer. `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` about `:674`: the row-actions trigger carries `aria-label="Row actions"`. That trigger is drawn on every row of a grid with row actions, so under `zh` a screen reader announces it in English.
- The same shape recurs across shipped sources: an `aria-label` written as an English literal, never read through the package's translation hook. Earlier single-site cards closed one position each (for example objectui#10104, #4474, #4645). No open card covers the family, so this card is its closing card.
- The enumeration below is the family as of this read. Re-check with:

  `git grep -n -E 'aria-label="[A-Z][a-z]' -- 'packages/*/src/**/*.tsx' 'apps/*/src/**/*.tsx'`, dropping `__tests__`, `.test.` and `.stories.` paths.

  It finds 31 sites in 9 packages. It is a lower bound: it does not see `aria-label={'…'}`, `title=` or `placeholder=` literals.

## Done when

- Each enumerated site reads its accessible name through its package's translation hook, with a key in every `@object-ui/i18n` pack (real translations).
- Or, where a site is shown not to reach a viewer (for example `DebugPanel`, if it is development-only), the PR says why it stays.
- The re-check command above returns no site outside that stated list.
- Pins: per package, one role-and-name query under `zh` reads the `zh` pack's name.

## Who acts, and in what order

- The `domain:ui` execution seat, after triage grades this card.
- Triage may slice it per package; the enumeration is the slicing list.
- Serial: `data-table.tsx` after PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12142 lands. `ObjectGrid.tsx` is not in this list.

## Dedupe

One repo-scoped issue search on objectui, open and closed: "hard-coded English aria-label not translated accessible names locale literal strings", 31 hits. The 25 read are all closed single-site or single-surface cards (objectui#11872, #11667, #11252, #10748, #10969, #10104, #9652, #4645, #4474, #4024 and others), and none is open on these sites.
